q: Can I get a custom celebration cake?
a: Yes. Ask at least 48 hours ahead for standard sizes and 5 days for tiered or sculpted cakes. Tell us the date, size and flavour.

q: Do you have eggless or vegan options?
a: Yes. Use the Eggless and Vegan filters in the menu. Each item lists its ingredients so you can check before you buy.

q: How long do your products stay fresh?
a: Everything is baked in-store each morning. Pastries are best the same day, cookies keep 5 days airtight and cakes keep 3 to 4 days refrigerated.

q: Do you cater for events and offices?
a: Yes. We supply pastry boxes, cake tables and coffee for events and offices. Send us your headcount and date through the contact details.
